source_spans.text: First of all, I agree with Duke Ellington because you can learn from your mistakes.
Secondly, I agree with Duke Ellington because you can improve on not making those mistakes.
Finally, I agree with Duke Ellington because you can describe your perspective to other people so they do not make those mistakes.
